prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished HIGH FIDELITY desktop application UI design comp, landscape 1536x1024, flat straight-on full screen interface filling the image, no laptop, browser chrome, perspective, photographic objects, decorative illustrations or watermark. This is a Russian professional document research application for researchers, engineers and analysts working at a desktop in a bright office. It is an operational product, not a marketing website. Render crisp readable Russian text and professional typography with sufficient contrast, precise alignments, generous but efficient whitespace. The product is NOT limited to surfactants or chemistry. Synapse is only the engine performing research.
SHARED CONTENT across design comparisons:
Application navigation has two active sections "Документы" and "Исследования". "Документы" is selected. A quiet lower navigation group labeled "Временно недоступно" lists disabled "Доказательная база", "Каталог источников", "Проверка опытов", "Контроль ТЗ". Disabled entries have no active visual affordance.
Main task title "Исследование по документам". Subtitle "Выберите источники и задайте исследовательский вопрос."
A document library section "Источники", action "+ Добавить документы", text "Выбрано 3 из 6", controls "Выбрать все" and "Снять выбор".
Exactly six compact document rows with checkboxes; first three checked:
"Обзор методов очистки воды.pdf" metadata "PDF · 42 стр."
"Результаты испытаний.csv" metadata "CSV · 128 строк"
"Технические требования.pdf" metadata "PDF · 18 стр."
"Протокол эксперимента.pdf" metadata "PDF · 24 стр."
"Описание оборудования.md" metadata "MD · 12 фрагментов"
"Библиография.bib" metadata "BIB · 36 записей".
Small open-original icon and separate discreet delete icon per row, delete not near checkbox.
Question section title "Исследовательский вопрос". Large multiline textarea contains "Сравните методы очистки воды по эффективности и ограничениям. На какие данные опираются выводы?" The selected-source count is visibly associated with the question.
One primary button "Запустить исследование" with simple right arrow. Secondary action "Найти фрагменты". Modest explanatory copy "Исследование подготовит ответ по выбранным источникам." and "Поиск покажет фрагменты документов." No generated answer yet, no imagined progress bars, no fabricated result, metrics, rating, percentages, user avatars or workflow builder.
Bottom subdued status "Synapse · Готов к запуску". A small clearly visible neutral label "Демонстрационные данные" indicates the files and question are samples. Other fine interface text should be minimal and in correct Russian. Use coherent UI icon line weights and accessible 44px controls. No PAV logo or wording. Mockup must look buildable as a real React application. All three main capabilities upload/select files, ask a question and start research must be obvious in the first viewport.
DIRECTION ATLAS. Product name exactly "Атлас", small descriptor "Исследования по документам". The structural idea is a technical atlas translated into a very calm professional workspace: small precise section numbers "01" for sources and "02" for the question act as coordinates, crisp light hairline boundaries, tabular numerical metadata, spatial clarity. No literal map, geographic illustration or node graph. Main composition: a slender light-gray left application sidebar 224px wide; beyond it a header line with small workspace context, then an understated 30px page title. Below that, TWO adjacent clearly proportioned workspace columns: 390px source library column and a wider right question area. Both columns begin on exactly the same horizontal baseline. Library fills naturally with six rows, not large cards; right area has the textarea and action bar beneath, plus calm purposeful blank space. The sole dominant focal element is the research button at the lower right of the question block.
Palette: very light cool canvas #f1f4f4, true white workspace areas #ffffff, deep petrol ink #173e46, terracotta #b54a31 for primary action. Light gray rules #d5dede. Checkbox selection and slim active-nav marker use deep petrol, not the terracotta action color. No full dark panels, green glow, gradient, purple AI styling, pills everywhere or giant rounded boxes. Border radii around 6px. Humanist sans-serif Russian typography for all text; small monospaced only numeric section indices and file metadata. Brand wordmark strong precise. Show the entire balanced opening screen, a finished UI not a wireframe.
